get.description: The process is up. Never touches the database.
The process is up and PostgreSQL answers ``SELECT 1`` (pooled engine).

post.description:
Sign in with a username and password; sets the session cookie.

Every login issues a new session; a live session on the request's cookie
is revoked. Any failure is the same ``401 invalid_credentials``. The body
carries the new session's ``csrf_token``. Needs the app's ``Origin``.
Too many attempts from one IP or for one username: ``429 rate_limited``
with ``Retry-After``, whether or not the account exists.

401.description: The username or password is incorrect.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Sign out: revoke the current session and clear the cookie.

Needs the app's ``Origin`` and the session's ``X-CSRF-Token``.

403.description: The request could not be verified (csrf_failed): the Origin or the X-CSRF-Token check failed.

get.description:
The signed-in user, their roles, their effective permissions and the
session's CSRF token (the same value for the whole session).

post.description:
Confirm the signed-in user's password for sensitive actions.

On success the **current** session counts as reauthenticated for 5
minutes from now (activity does not extend it; a later reauthentication
restarts it). A wrong password is ``403 reauth_failed``; the session stays
signed in and its window is unchanged. Needs the app's ``Origin`` and the
session's ``X-CSRF-Token``. After 5 wrong passwords for the user in a
15-minute window, further attempts get ``429 rate_limited`` with
``Retry-After``, without a password check; the session and its window are
unchanged.

403.description: The password is incorrect (reauth_failed), or a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Change the signed-in user's password, given the current one.

On success every session of the user ends, including this one, and a new
session replaces it: the response sets the new cookie and carries the new
session's ``csrf_token`` (the old cookie and token stop working). Any
outstanding reset link of the user stops working. A new password that
breaks the policy is ``422`` and costs no attempt. A wrong current
password is ``403 current_password_invalid``; the session stays signed in.
Wrong current passwords count against the same budget as
``POST /reauthenticate``: after 5 in 15 minutes, ``429 rate_limited`` with
``Retry-After``, without a password check and without changing the
session. Needs the app's ``Origin`` and the session's ``X-CSRF-Token``.

403.description: The current password is incorrect (current_password_invalid), or a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed).

429.description: Too many attempts (rate_limited). Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limit's window ends.

post.description:
Invite a person for one role: a pending user without a password and a
one-time link, valid for 24 hours, shown in this response only.

The caller must be allowed to assign the role (``403 permission_denied``).
Owner, Administrator, Academic coordinator and Finance staff need a
password reauthentication in the last 5 minutes (``403
reauth_required``).

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required).

post.description:
Issue a one-time password-reset link for another user, valid for 24
hours, shown in this response only. A new link replaces the previous one.

Needs a password reauthentication in the last 5 minutes (``403
reauth_required``). Only an Owner may reset an Owner or an Administrator,
and nobody resets their own account (``403 permission_denied``; use
``POST /api/v1/auth/password``). The user must be active (``409
user_not_active``). Their sessions end when the link is redeemed.

403.description: Permission denied (permission_denied); a failed Origin or X-CSRF-Token check (csrf_failed); or the session needs a recent password reauthentication (reauth_required).

post.description:

410.description: The link is unknown, malformed, used, replaced or expired, or the account is no longer active (token_invalid).

post.description:
Request an account as a parent or guardian, or as a student.

Creates a pending account that cannot sign in until an Owner or
Administrator approves it. Never links or enrolls anyone. Needs the app's
``Origin``. Every request counts against the hourly limit.
